reviewer.relationship: Independent read-only review of the native caller and specialist outputs; reviewer did not produce the native allocation.

scope: Source-level semantic review of retained baseline/final allocation, captured complete source reads, coverage/source map, caller/specialist narratives and caller preservation observations. This is a development-assistant review, not human or artistic acceptance.

observed_findings.observation: shortcutEntry imports and calls startShortcut; startShortcut calls statusCell("idle"); statusVisuals.idle resolves to assets/start.svg. The final allocation adds both consumers to queue.start and does not create another asset role.

The source map correctly traces started -> running -> Working, ok -> succeeded -> Ready, and error -> failed -> Retry through stateAfter and the shared statusVisuals mapping. It includes statusCell and compactStatus and explicitly notes that stateAfter does not produce idle.

Baseline/final comparison shows only coverage, two new source bindings, and the Start consumer/observation additions. All original source declarations and requirements remain unchanged. The new added_consumer entry is explicitly an observation of the inspected call chain, not an invented style or production requirement. Unrelated asset rows, production and evidence fields are unchanged.

The old queue-view stored hash remains intact while reports identify its current observed hash and retained drift. The caller distinguishes conservative shared-file impact from the changed Start requirements identity and does not treat impact as a regeneration order.

The reports distinguish existing SVG source, its added reuse, three absent PNG destinations, the inspected accountBadge lookup with unavailable registry contents, and the present renderer deliberately marked not_inspected. The renderer has no inferred symbols, consumers or behavior claims.

The specialist and caller limit their claims to allocation and source inspection. They do not claim rendered inspection, animation playback, visual quality, target-engine acceptance or artistic acceptance. The native specialist claim of no runtime execution is scoped to its work; fixture preparation has a separate descriptor-reachability observation.

limits: Reviewed retained source text and tool-result artifacts; did not rerun the native trial or independently audit every native tool event.
Mechanical provenance, exact byte/hash verification and host qualification belong to the separate grader receipts; this review does not replace those checks.
No renderer contents were inspected for this review, and no remote account registry contents were available.
No image rendering, visual inspection, artistic judgment, target-engine integration or human acceptance was performed.
This bounded CF-06 observation does not establish exhaustive project coverage, broad host reliability, or M1/M2 acceptance.
